_source: Cast list from the film's English Wikipedia article, section 'Cast' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious:_Tokyo_Drift). Wikipedia decides WHO EXISTS. The transcript is used only to check spelling and romanisation, never to decide membership.
_why_this_matters: An earlier version of this file was built FROM THE TRANSCRIPT, and dropped Neela - the female lead - because Whisper never produced her name. A fuzzy search over every word in the transcript found nothing within 0.67 similarity of 'Neela'; the closest tokens were 'need', 'near', 'feel'. Earl, Reiko, Clay, Cindy, Dominic and Toretto are likewise absent. A transcript is evidence about SPELLING, not about existence, and using it as a roster silently deletes anyone the ASR missed.

_transcript_check.confirmed_spelling: Sean x4, Boswell x3, Twinkie x1 (+ 'Twink' x3), Han x1, Takashi x3, Kamata x1 (+ Kamata's x2), Morimoto x1
_transcript_check.absent_from_transcript: Neela, Earl, Reiko, Clay, Cindy, Dominic, Toretto - present in the film, absent from the ASR output. Kept anyway, on Wikipedia's authority.
_transcript_check.near_misses_seen: Kamara/Kamada for Kamata, Hawn for Han, Twink for Twinkie - ASR variants, not separate characters.

_spoiler_note: Dominic Toretto is listed here because he IS in the cast. Listing him does NOT license naming him early: reveal R4 protects him until 01:36:38, the frame his face first appears. names.json answers 'does this person exist'; the reveal-map answers 'when may the recap say so'. The two are separate and both apply.
_discrepancy: Asked for as 'Major Boswell'. Wikipedia credits Brian Goodman as 'Lieutenant Boswell' and the plot text calls him a U.S. Navy lieutenant. Following Wikipedia, as instructed; flagging the difference rather than silently picking one.
